text: in hmsc-int the studio mesh editor is maturing fast. i need you to get me full coverage of features and how it behaves in a md file i can digest. keep things bulleted and detail how things work lightly, but get full named coverage of features and capabilities
resolution: Created a digestible full feature-coverage map for the hmsc-int Studio mesh editor at cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/STUDIO_MESH_EDITOR_FEATURE_COVERAGE.md. It surveys the active studiokit editor and documents the current named capabilities across entry points, persistence, viewport/camera, outliner/library, add/import, selection modes, transforms, symmetry, mesh ops, rig/anchors, UV/texture, paint, backdrops, compile/cooked assets, diagnostics, shortcuts, and source files so the maturing editor can be understood without spelunking the implementation.
